import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.ArrayDeque;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Queue;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, capacity, flow;
        Edge rev;

        public Edge(int to, int capacity, Edge rev) {
            this.to = to;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.rev = rev;
        }
    }

    static class FlowGraph {
        int n;
        Edge[] adj;
        int[] d, p;

        public FlowGraph(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            adj = new Edge[n];
            d = new int[n];
            p = new int[n];
        }

        public void addEdge(int u, int v, int capacity) {
            adj[u] = new Edge(v, capacity, adj[v]);
            adj[v] = new Edge(u, 0, null);
        }

        public boolean makeLevelGraph(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(d, -1);
            d[s] = 0;
            Queue<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                    if (e.capacity - e.flow > 0 && d[e.to] == -1) {
                        d[e.to] = d[u] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return d[t] != -1;
        }

        public boolean dfs(int u, int t) {
            if (u == t) return true;
            for (Edge e : adj[u]) {
                if (d[e.to] == d[u] + 1 && e.capacity - e.flow > 0 && dfs(e.to, t)) {
                    p[e.to] = u;
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        public boolean findAugPath(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(p, -1);
            p[s] = 0;
            return dfs(s, t);
        }

        public void updateFlow(int u, int v, int delta) {
            adj[u].rev.flow += delta;
            adj[v].flow -= delta;
        }

        public int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int maxFlowValue = 0;
            while (makeLevelGraph(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(p, -1);
                p[s] = 0;
                while (dfs(s, t)) {
                    int b = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                    for (int v = t; v != s; v = p[v]) {
                        b = Math.min(b, adj[p[v]].rev.capacity - adj[p[v]].rev.flow);
                    }
                    for (int v = t; v != s; v = p[v]) {
                        adj[p[v]].rev.updateFlow(p[v], v, b);
                    }
                    maxFlowValue += b;
                }
            }
            return maxFlowValue;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        String[] line = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(line[0]);
        int t = Integer.parseInt(line[1]);
        char[][] g = new char[n][n];
        int[][] n_scientists = new int[n][n];
        int[][] n_rescue = new int[n][n];
        int[][] infect_time = new int[n][n];
        int[][] reach_time = new int[n][n][n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            line = br.readLine().split("");
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                g[i][j] = line[j].charAt(0);
                if (g[i][j] == 'Y') {
                    g[i][j] = 'Y';
                } else if (g[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    g[i][j] = 'Z';
                } else {
                    n_scientists[i][j] += line[j].charAt(0) - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            line = br.readLine().split("");
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (line[j].charAt(0) != 'Y' && line[j].charAt(0) != 'Z') {
                    n_rescue[i][j] += line[j].charAt(0) - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        int explode_i = -1, explode_j = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (g[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    explode_i = i;
                    explode_j = j;
                }
            }
        }
        infect_time[explode_i][explode_j] = 0;
        java.util.Queue<int[]> q = new java.util.ArrayDeque<>();
        q.add(new int[]{explode_i, explode_j});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int i = p[0], j = p[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int ni = i + d / 2 * 2 - 1, nj = j + d % 2 * 2 - 1;
                if (0 <= ni && ni < n && 0 <= nj && nj < n && g[ni][nj] == '.' && infect_time[ni][nj] == -1) {
                    infect_time[ni][nj] = infect_time[i][j] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (g[i][j] == '.') {
                    for (int ii = 0; ii < n; ii++) {
                        for (int jj = 0; jj < n; jj++) {
                            reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] = -1;
                        }
                    }
                    reach_time[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                    q = new java.util.ArrayDeque<>();
                    q.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] p = q.poll();
                        int ii = p[0], jj = p[1];
                        if (infect_time[ii][jj] == -1 || reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] < infect_time[ii][jj]) {
                            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                                int ni = ii + d / 2 * 2 - 1, nj = jj + d % 2 * 2 - 1;
                                if (0 <= ni && ni < n && 0 <= nj && nj < n && g[ni][nj] == '.'
                                        && (infect_time[ni][nj] == -1 || reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] + 1 <= infect_time[ni][nj])
                                        && reach_time[i][j][ni][nj] == -1) {
                                    reach_time[i][j][ni][nj] = reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] + 1;
                                    q.add(new int[]{ni, nj});
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int src = 2 * n * n, sink = 2 * n * n + 1;
        FlowGraph fg = new FlowGraph(2 * n * n + 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (n_scientists[i][j] > 0) {
                    fg.addEdge(src, node(n, i, j, false), n_scientists[i][j]);
                }
                if (n_rescue[i][j] > 0) {
                    fg.addEdge(node(n, i, j, true), sink, n_rescue[i][j]);
                }
                for (int ii = 0; ii < n; ii++) {
                    for (int jj = 0; jj < n; jj++) {
                        if (0 <= reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] && reach_time[i][j][ii][jj] <= t) {
                            fg.addEdge(node(n, i, j, false), node(n, ii, jj, true), Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        pw.println(fg.maxFlow(src, sink));
        pw.close();
    }

    static int node(int n, int i, int j, boolean right) {
        return i * n + j + (right ? n * n : 0);
    }
}
